}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "WAC740-720_beta1.0 REV 2.0" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
"D9PTK" [https://www.micron.com/support/tools-and-utilities/fbga?fbga=D9PTK FBGA code] on the RAM corresponds to the MT41K128M16JT-125:K
<small> The CPU ID is not clearly legible in the FCC photos but it strongly resembles the BCM58535 :in the [[Cisco WAP581]] and is presumed to be one of the [[Broadcom#Northstar_Plus|Northstar Plus]] models. </small>
